tracklist: Anyway You Want Me (That's How I Will Be)
I Want You, I Need You, I Love You

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (14 tracks) per https://En.Citizendium.org/wiki/Elvis%27_Golden_Records, https://www.theingroove.com/products/elvis-presley-elvis-golden-records-speakers-corner-lp. 1958 RCA Victor compilation of 1956-57 hit singles (LPM-1707), widely cited as the first rock-and-roll greatest-hits album. 14 tracks in two LP sides; sequence identical across Citizendium, MusicChartsArchive, The In Groove reissue listing and RareVinyl first-pressing listing.
